reserveReview.rationale: D24 withdraws positive gross holdings normalized to 100% as a score-bearing full reserve mix. The dated issuer API checkpoint is 2026-09-29T23:59:59+00:00: assetsUsd $1,011,936,129.476998, liabilitiesUsd $885,894,748.9042089 and netNav $126,041,395.5232356. Gross assets less financing debt is $126,041,380.57278907, differing from reported NAV by $14.950446531176567; this is not assigned to a reserve category. Separate net category observations are Stablecoins $126,027,621.43236, Other $17,174,455.05716633, ETH & Derivatives $5,235.589536695818, AVAX & Derivatives $4,256.230927363616, BTC & Derivatives $16.06278631451855 and Perpetuals -$17,170,200.187363. Gross source-labelled longs include USDe $752,785,025.0275809, syrupUSDT $101,669,719.2526256, syrupUSDC $51,815,645.40187984, USDC $41,391,448.65783945 and aMonUSDe $40,868,671.47333708. These remain contextual observations, not full backing weights or verified token identities. No reconciled whole-token composition, enforceable cross-venue debt netting, receipt look-through or holder-exitable loss coefficients are disclosed in the reviewed API and strategy registry. All score-bearing composition exposure therefore stays unknown; this 100% row measures the evidence boundary, not an invented residual asset.
